question: How does abstention from eating affect death associated with aging?
premises: Non-eating is practiced day by day.
Aging and death are linked conditions.
The practice leads beyond that death.
inference: Through daily non-eating, one will go beyond death associated with aging.
uncertainties: nāśanena may mean fasting or complete abstention; gamiṣyate may imply overcoming rather than undergoing
plain_english: By daily abstention from food, one will go beyond death caused by aging.
